title: Wire ISO post: optional codes so a machine file can target GF AgieCharmilles / Charmilles ISO controls

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

The generic wire ISO post writes every EDM code from the machine file's `edm.codes`. A machine file cannot make it write a program that a Charmilles CT-Millennium or GF AgieCharmilles ISO control accepts and fully sets up. No shipped machine file targets these controls, so this is support for a new dialect. These items are missing:

1. The unit word is on one block with `G90 G17`. The Charmilles ISO manual wants `G20` / `G21` alone on its block.
2. The post always writes the work-offset word (for example `G54`). The Charmilles ISO control has no `G54`-`G59`. It sets the origin with `G92 X Y`.
3. The reference and secondary plane heights (`G92 ... I J`) are only in a comment.
4. The corner rule (`WireCorner`) is only in a comment. The post writes no corner mode (`G60`-`G63`).
5. The post has no code for the tank and the flushing. It writes a "set it at the control" note.
6. The post has no code to load the technology and wire tables (`G11`).
7. The 4-axis U V words are the upper-guide offset. The Charmilles `M15 P11` form is a vector at the workpiece surface.

## Expected

Optional `edm.codes` entries let a machine file state each item:

- a unit block alone,
- the origin word, or no work-offset word,
- the plane-height template,
- the corner codes,
- the tank and flushing codes,
- the table-load lines,
- the meaning of the U V words.

Each entry is optional. When a machine file does not state it, the output does not change.

## Evidence (upstream main `eafe6aec6`)

- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:193`: `G21 G90 G17` on one block.
- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:202`, `:284` and `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:302`: the work-offset word is always written.
- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:268`, `:281-282`: the plane height and the corner rule go into comments.
- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:186-192`: the tank and flushing notes (#1499 and #2686 did this for the Sodick post only).
- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps:296-314`: `startCut` has no table-load line.
- Golden `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/wire-iso/wire_taper_angle_punch.nc` shows `G21 G90 G17` and `G54`.
- Tapered arcs are not in this issue: #3941.

Found by the post audit against the GF AgieCharmilles manuals (#4130).

## Done means

- A synthetic Charmilles-style machine file posts a 2-axis cut and a taper with these entries. Goldens pin both.
- The existing wire-iso goldens do not change.
